name: drinksup
description: Drinks Up e-commerce — storefront (frontend/), admin dashboard (admin/), API (backend/), PostgreSQL (database/)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix database install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix admin install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n db,api,store,admin -c blue,green,magenta,cyan "npm --prefix database run dev" "wait-on tcp:5433 && npm --prefix backend run serve:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix admin run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix admin run build
